controls: Only Team A focal attribute +4 on all its players; gk only on keepers. All other attributes, team B, role specialization, age, form, freshness, instructions, tactics, seeds and venue order held constant. No coaching/substitutions. Fresh career clone each game.

primaryMetrics.spd: bounded field-player travel metres per game
primaryMetrics.tec: ground duel win rate (all duels minus aerial)
primaryMetrics.fin: on-target rate per completed intentional attempt
primaryMetrics.gk: save rate per faced intentional target shot

analysis: Paired 30-seed bootstrap, 10000 resamples; intervals exploratory, no multiple-comparison correction. Match outcomes descriptive; no requirement that every isolated attribute raises wins in 30 games.
fixedScenes: Each attribute varied alone in identical native scenes; improved primary mechanism required. No balance tuning to match sample.
scope: Single-attribute isolation across a team; no positional/player-level isolation, tactics or rare-animation expansion.
